items.text: The Activity tab now shows each recent file with its thumbnail or file type icon.
The status line and setup now use one shared progress ring instead of mixed loading indicators.
Local file management is much stronger, with better cleanup timing, safer removal behavior, and clearer totals for what is stored on this Mac.
Startup and availability are more reliable, including opening at login, Finder folder recovery at launch, and smoother behavior while services are still starting.
The Activity tab now supports faster file follow-up, including Finder reveal, one-click sharing, and consistent file ordering on shared links.
Finder presentation is improved with file thumbnails, upload status visibility, and window colors that match light and dark mode.
Folder trash and restore behavior is now consistent across devices, including restoring files back into their original folder paths.
Files replaced from another device no longer mix old and new content while being read.
Updates and upload progress are more dependable, with clearer progress display, fresher downloaded updates, storage-full handling, and retry behavior that backs off before trying again.
Files moved to trash before upload now leave the upload queue and stay unshared until restored.
